name: Saheena
description: An old one-eyed Vulshok woman and cell member with two sons, who stays with Neyali as honor guard.

timeline.summary: Neyali takes stock of her weary cell on the edge of the Quiet Furnace, recalling how she searched alone with Otharri before gathering them.
timeline.quote: Now, people depended on her. Trusted her.

timeline.summary: Neyali, Elham, Saheena and her sons set off for the Salvage Complex, finding Mirran camps where loved ones vanished with no sign of force.
timeline.quote: that loved ones had gone missing, with no signs that they'd been taken by force.
